question: GQ-006
subject: launchd fleet health — found while tracing one dead collector

causal_chain.2: So repos.db was never repopulated. It sits at 0 bytes, last modified 2026-07-22.

scope_caveat: 36 failing jobs is a count, not a diagnosis. Some may be intentionally disabled, superseded, or one-shot jobs whose exit code is stale. I traced ONE chain to its root and am reporting the rest as a count with its codes — not as 36 defects.
not_fixed: Nothing repaired. These are Shaan's operational jobs, not Library artifacts, and reconstructing a missing script would be building on a guess.
